question: Identify the league that had the fewest total goals (home + away) across all matches in the 2015/2016 season, among only those leagues where at least one team lost fewer than 3 matches as the home team during that same season.

prediction.sql:
WITH HomeLossCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        m.XCL_013 AS TeamID,
        COUNT(*) AS LossCount
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, m.XCL_013
),
EligibleLeagues AS (
    SELECT LeagueID
    FROM HomeLossCounts
    GROUP BY LeagueID
    HAVING MIN(LossCount) < 3
),
LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        l.XCL_005 AS LeagueName,
        SUM(m.XCL_015) + SUM(m.XCL_016) AS TotalGoals
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, l.XCL_005
)
SELECT 
    lg.LeagueName
FROM LeagueGoals lg
JOIN EligibleLeagues el ON lg.LeagueID = el.LeagueID
ORDER BY lg.TotalGoals ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH HomeLossCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        m.XCL_013 AS TeamID,
        COUNT(*) AS LossCount
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, m.XCL_013
),
EligibleLeagues AS (
    SELECT LeagueID
    FROM HomeLossCounts
    GROUP BY LeagueID
    HAVING MIN(LossCount) < 3
),
LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        l.XCL_005 AS LeagueName,
        SUM(m.XCL_015) + SUM(m.XCL_016) AS TotalGoals
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, l.XCL_005
)
SELECT 
    lg.LeagueName
FROM LeagueGoals lg
JOIN EligibleLeagues el ON lg.LeagueID = el.LeagueID
ORDER BY lg.TotalGoals ASC
LIMIT 1

    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, l.XCL_005
)

WITH HomeLossCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        m.XCL_013 AS TeamID,
        COUNT(*) AS LossCount
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, m.XCL_013
),
EligibleLeagues AS (
    SELECT LeagueID
    FROM HomeLossCounts
    GROUP BY LeagueID
    HAVING MIN(LossCount) < 3
),
LeagueGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        l.XCL_003 AS LeagueID,
        l.XCL_005 AS LeagueName,
        SUM(m.XCL_015) + SUM(m.XCL_016) AS TotalGoals
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
    WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003, l.XCL_005
)
SELECT 
    lg.LeagueName
FROM LeagueGoals lg
JOIN EligibleLeagues el ON lg.LeagueID = el.LeagueID
ORDER BY lg.TotalGoals ASC
LIMIT 1
